SELECT 1 FROM pf.execution_dispatch d JOIN pf.attempt a ON a.task_id=d.task_id JOIN pf.conversation_lease v ON v.attempt_id=a.id WHERE d.task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND d.status='CLAIMED' AND d.lease_owner=#{ownerId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND d.fencing_token=#{fence,jdbcType=OTHER} AND d.lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND a.id=#{attemptId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND a.space_id=#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND a.owner_id=#{ownerId2,jdbcType=OTHER} AND a.fencing_token=#{fence2,jdbcType=OTHER} AND a.status='RUNNING' AND a.dispatch_generation=d.generation AND v.space_id=#{spaceId2,jdbcType=OTHER} AND v.conversation_id=#{conversationId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND v.owner_id=#{ownerId3,jdbcType=OTHER} AND v.fencing_token=#{fence3,jdbcType=OTHER} AND v.generation=d.generation AND v.lease_until>clock_timestamp() FOR UPDATE OF d,a,v

SELECT lease_until AS __column1 FROM pf.execution_slot WHERE id=1 AND task_id=#{taskId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND owner_id=#{ownerId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND fencing_token=#{fence,jdbcType=OTHER} AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() FOR UPDATE
SELECT task_id AS __column1, fencing_token AS __column2 FROM pf.execution_slot WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT 1 FROM pf.consumer_inbox WHERE consumer_name='execution' AND event_id=#{eventId,jdbcType=OTHER}

SELECT d.task_id AS __column1, d.generation AS __column2, t.space_id AS __column3, t.creator_id AS __column4 FROM pf.execution_dispatch d JOIN pf.task t ON t.id=d.task_id WHERE d.status='DEFERRED' AND d.available_at<=now() AND t.status='QUEUED' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.execution_slot WHERE task_id IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.task prior WHERE prior.conversation_id=t.conversation_id AND prior.status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING') AND (prior.created_at,prior.id)<(t.created_at,t.id)) ORDER BY t.created_at,t.id FOR UPDATE OF d SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM pf.event_outbox WHERE (status='PENDING' AND available_at<=now()) OR (status='PUBLISHING' AND publish_lease_until<now()) ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 100
SELECT count(*) AS __column1, min(created_at) AS __column2 FROM pf.event_outbox WHERE status IN ('PENDING','PUBLISHING','REVIEW')
SELECT task_id AS __column1, owner_id AS __column2, fencing_token AS __column3, lease_until AS __column4, clock_timestamp() AS __column5 FROM pf.execution_slot WHERE id=1

UPDATE pf.event_outbox SET status=CASE WHEN attempts>=10 THEN 'REVIEW' ELSE 'PENDING' END,available_at=now()+make_interval(secs=>CASE WHEN attempts=1 THEN 1 WHEN attempts=2 THEN 5 WHEN attempts=3 THEN 30 WHEN attempts=4 THEN 120 ELSE 600 END),publish_lease_until=NULL,last_error='PUBLISH_NOT_CONFIRMED' WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND publish_owner=#{relay,jdbcType=OTHER} AND status='PUBLISHING'
UPDATE pf.execution_slot SET id=id WHERE id=1

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.attempt(id,space_id,task_id,ordinal,owner_id,fencing_token,dispatch_generation) SELECT #{attempt,jdbcType=OTHER},space_id,id,(SELECT count(*)+1 FROM pf.attempt WHERE task_id=#{aggregateId,jdbcType=OTHER}),#{owner,jdbcType=OTHER},#{fence,jdbcType=OTHER},#{generation,jdbcType=OTHER} FROM pf.task WHERE id=#{aggregateId2,jdbcType=OTHER}

INSERT INTO pf.conversation_lease(space_id,conversation_id,task_id,attempt_id,owner_id,generation,fencing_token,lease_until) VALUES(#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{convo,jdbcType=OTHER},#{aggregateId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{attempt,jdbcType=OTHER},#{owner,jdbcType=OTHER},#{generation,jdbcType=OTHER},#{fence,jdbcType=OTHER},now()+interval '60 seconds') ON CONFLICT(space_id,conversation_id) DO UPDATE SET task_id=excluded.task_id,attempt_id=excluded.attempt_id,owner_id=excluded.owner_id,generation=excluded.generation,fencing_token=excluded.fencing_token,lease_until=excluded.lease_until

INSERT INTO pf.consumer_inbox(consumer_name,event_id,space_id,aggregate_id,generation,disposition) VALUES('execution',#{eventId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{spaceId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{aggregateId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{generation,jdbcType=OTHER},#{disposition,jdbcType=OTHER}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
